text: The historical wrapper comment says the security-info pointer is null when there was a security error, but the TransportSecurityFailure branch supplies the cloned payload and other branches use null. Accepted current text adds the missing no. Preserve the exact condition when explaining this pointer: valid type and nullability do not prove who releases a forgotten reference. The existing ownership-gap lesson remains unresolved. This is a scoped comment correction example, not an inferred leak, a global safety proof or a technical backout cause. No TLS or ownership test ran.
title: The outgoing pointer comment must match the transport-security payload branch
